import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

table = pd.read_csv("table.csv")
print(table.to_string(index=False))
print(Path("summary.txt").read_text())

path = Path("chart.py")
script = path.read_text()
script = script.replace("data=df[df['Education_Stage'] != 'Tertiary'],", "data=df,")
script = script.replace("legend=False", "legend=True")
path.write_text(script)
exec(compile(script, "chart.py", "exec"))

ax = plt.gca()
print("Legend:", [t.get_text() for t in ax.get_legend().get_texts()])
print("Bar count:", len(ax.patches))
print("Title:", ax.get_title())
print("Limits:", ax.get_xlim(), ax.get_ylim())

import numpy as np
from matplotlib.container import BarContainer

stages = list(table["Education_Stage"].drop_duplicates())
regions = [t.get_text() for t in ax.get_yticklabels()]
containers = [c for c in ax.containers if isinstance(c, BarContainer)]
assert len(containers) == 4
for stage, container in zip(stages, containers):
    expected = table[table["Education_Stage"] == stage].set_index("Region").loc[regions, "Gender_Completion_Gap"]
    np.testing.assert_allclose([p.get_width() for p in container.patches], expected.values, atol=1e-12)
assert [t.get_text() for t in ax.get_legend().get_texts()] == stages
print("Verified all 36 bars against table.csv and all four legend entries. Repairs complete.")
